Definition: Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim
BiblicalUsage: Lᵉbânâʼ is the name of Lebana or Lebanah, one of the Nethinim. In Ezra 2:45, "The children of Lebanah"; and in Nehemiah 7:48, "The children of Lebana".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Nethinim matter — Lebana's children came back from exile to serve in the house of God, and their names are written down. I hold that God remembers the servants, not only the kings.
